o.text: Internationalism; via Russian морфология (morfologija). Ultimately from Ancient Greek μορφή (morphḗ, “shape, form”) and -λογία (-logía).
Ultimately from French biologie, reinterpreted as an adjective.
Borrowed from Arabic فَرْدِيّ (fardiyy). By surface analysis, fərd + -i.
